title: Johnson wins world downhill title after ban
text:
Brezy Johnson, born in Wyoming, is only the fourth American woman to win a title down the World Championship (Getty Images)
American Brezy Johnson won the gold of the World Women’s World Championship, the first important title of his career, only weeks after returning from a 14 -month prohibition.
The 29 -year -old returned to the World Cup circuit in December after Serving a suspension For three anti -doping failures of the whereabouts.
Johnson, whose career has also been ruined by the injuries, established a winning time of a minute 41.29 seconds with the opening of the day in Saalbach, Austria.
“When I met the line and I saw that it was a bass 41, I was like ‘incredible,” said Johnson, who became the first American to win gold downhill from Lindsey vonn in Val d’A iseere in 2009.
He faced an anxious wait to celebrate, but nobody could match his time, with Mirjam Puchner of Austria taking Silver 0.15 seconds and Checo Bronze Ester Ledecka, another later 0.06.
Vonn, the 2010 Olympic champion who returned to the championships at the age of 40 years after retiring in 2019, was 15th, since he left the super g on Thursday.
“It’s a bit stressful to sit in the leader’s chair, but it’s much more difficult to sit there on top waiting for your career,” Johnson told NBC Sports Television. “I was definitely grateful to run the number one.”
Johnson was prohibited by the United States anti -doping agency in May for missing three drug tests in a 12 -month window, with its supported suspension until October 2023.
In a publication about her Instagram account, She said there had been “a problem with the drug testers that could find me”, recognizing their “human error”, but adding “all my tests have been clean.”
The 2018 Olympic has never won a World Cup race, with a better second -second end, while the last of its seven podiums at the sport elite level arrived in 2021.
The Swiss rookie Franjo Von Allmen won the male descent title on Sunday in what was his first appearance in an important championship.
The 23 -year -old became the youngest male descent champion in 36 years, hitting the 2021 Austria winner, Vincent Kriechmayr, secondly for 0.24 seconds.
Three of the first five were Swiss, with the third of Alexis Monney and defending champion Marco Odermatt ending fifth.
